params.text:
On Apple's online store, the 13-inch MacBook Air in Sky Blue with the M5 chip option featuring the **10-core GPU** (10-core CPU, 10-core GPU, 16-core Neural Engine) starts at **From $1,399** (or $116.58/mo. for 12 months).

For reference, the other chip option (10-core CPU, 8-core GPU) starts at $1,299.
